utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I really appreciate you helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — I can help with the fence panel by the alley. Just tell me when to come by and what materials you need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be a big help, Leo. I’ll let you know the timing and what we need for the fence panel.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I can sort the repair items and keep track of the donations as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’m still able to help — I’ll sort the repair items and keep track of the donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the hardware store on Pine and the community center bulletin board for any repair-drive flyers, and I’ll let you know where and when I find them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, so let me know what you find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll look for any flyers and send you the details if I spot them. Thanks for the update about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll jot down the basics and keep it tidy. If you tell me what’s needed most, we can match the next repair to that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — we’ve got the basics to sort: tell me the main repair items, and I’ll keep the list tidy so we can match you to the next one.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll make sure everyone knows we’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thank you, Mara — I appreciate it. Maple Street this Saturday is perfect; I’ll see everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You’re welcome, Opal — I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know the spot. See you Saturday on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — let me know what you find, and I can help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Bo — I’m a little foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help once you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be late as usual, but I’ll head to the Maple Street spot Saturday and jump in wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, Dane — Maple Street on Saturday works, and late is fine; just bring any tools you’ve got and an hour if you can spare it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll bring what I can and help out wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we set the date for the repair drive yet, and what do they still need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet — I’m still sorting the date, but I’ll keep everyone posted. Right now I’m checking what they need most for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. Please let me know as soon as the date’s set and what they need most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the time and drop-off spot so I can figure out what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m checking on the exact time and drop-off spot now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. For now, we’re still set for the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, thanks — I’ll hold off until you confirm the exact time and drop-off spot. Maple Street this Saturday helps, but I still need the details to plan what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — that’d be really helpful. If you can check the latest list, I’ll pass it along to the other neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll check the latest list and ask about the date, what to bring, and the drop-off spot, then I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. I’ll pass along whatever you find out to the other neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What’s on the list? I can help with the next repair.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I’ll plan around 3:30 to 5:00 and make sure it fits the pickup rush.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there then and ready to help with whatever repair comes up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll be ready when you swing by with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Noah — I’ll bring a hammer and screwdriver by soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks—just come by whenever you’re ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. What should we line up first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me, even if I’m late. Let’s start with the leaky faucet first, then the porch step and hallway light as we can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll put the leaky faucet first and keep the porch step and hallway light on the list. I’ll line up supplies and let everyone know the Sunday plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, still happy to help — just point me to what you need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just give me the time and I’ll help haul the materials.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll send you the time once it’s set. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’d still love to hear if they’re short on volunteers or any other supplies, if you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll ask around and let you know if they need more volunteers or supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the date yet, but I can pass along that folks should bring tools and an hour if they can spare it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good start. I’ll keep it tidy and note that we still need the date.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — once the date’s set, I’ll let neighbors know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m still able to help. I just need to work around school pickup, so I can come after that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. What time after pickup works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I can sort the repair items and keep track of the donations as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’s a relief. I’m still a bit worried about the drop-off spot and what needs to be brought, so please keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on the drop-off spot and let you know what’s needed as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That means a lot, Sam. Thank you for helping sort everything and keep track of the donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m glad to help. Just tell me what needs sorting or counting next.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can start with the donation boxes if you’re ready, Sam. Thanks again for taking this on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still in, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. If you want, I can also round up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be great. I’ve got the repair drive spot pinned on Maple Street this Saturday, so send anyone you round up there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll pass along Maple Street this Saturday and see if I can bring a few more neighbors along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we already set the date for the repair drive, and can you check what they need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — it’s set for this Saturday at the repair drive spot on Maple Street, and I’ll check what they need most right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know what they need most when you find out?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know we’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that’s the spot I was hearing about — I’ll still check what they want folks to bring and make sure everyone knows the drop-off details. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. Just let me know the bring-list and drop-off details when you hear back, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—what’s on the list? I can help with the next repair.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the list. I might’ve missed the details again, but I’m in if you need help with the next repair.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — just tell me what you can help fix first, and I’ll put you on it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’m ready to start with the leaky faucet, and we can take care of the porch step and hallway light after you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. I’m happy to help with the leaky faucet, and just point me to the porch step and hallway light when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep an eye out for you and point you to the porch step and hallway light when you arrive.
